# Letter files (`letters/*.letter.json`)

One JSON document per cover letter, `"format": "enginecv.letter/v1"`. Schema: https://enginecv.app/schema/letter/v1.json. Fields you leave out stay as they are; an empty string clears a field.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Read only. A changed id makes a new letter. |
| `status` | Read only. `"draft"` or `"sent"`. |
| `cv` | `{ "id": "<CV id from index.json>", "title": "<hint>" }`. The letter follows that CV. Only `id` matters. |
| `standalone` | `true` for a letter with no CV. Then put sender details in `sender`. |
| `edited_by` | Optional. Your name, for example `Claude Code`; shown in a notification. |
| `title`, `company`, `role`, `subject`, `salutation`, `closing` | Text. |
| `language`, `date` | Language code; date as `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `layout`, `paper` | `"standard"` or `"din5008"` (German business letter); `"a4"` or `"letter"`. din5008 is A4 only. |
| `recipient` | `{ name, address }` (address lines separated by `\n`). |
| `paragraphs` | Array of Markdown strings, in order. This is the body. |
| `sender` | Only the sender fields you want to override (name, email, phone, ...). |
| `design` | Only the design fields you want to override (accentColor, ...). |

## Tokens

`{{name}}`, `{{role}}`, `{{location}}` and `{{skills}}` are filled from the linked CV when the letter is shown or exported. Write them as they are; never replace a token with its value. Any other `{{word}}` stays as written text, so write the company's name out.

## Rules

- A letter with `"status": "sent"` is frozen. Edits to its file are refused with `sent-letter`. To reuse it, write a new letter file with a new `id`.
- A letter that names a CV id EngineCV does not have stays a draft marked "Needs a CV". Use an id from `.enginecv/index.json`.
- To change the CV a letter follows, change `cv.id`.
- A new file with no `id` becomes a new letter. Give it `cv` or `standalone`.
- Links in paragraphs: only http, https, mailto and tel become links.
